seed_semantics: Reference sklearn uses its own MT19937-derived tree seeds. Native records a versioned RNG scheme and derives each tree seed independently; identical sklearn trees are not required.

acceptance.sample_to_patient: Equal mean of the two lesion probabilities or regression scores per test patient, before metrics. Sample metrics retained separately.
acceptance.regression: native mean RMSE - reference mean RMSE <= max(reference mean RMSE*0.10, test target population std*0.02)
acceptance.reproducibility: Within native implementation, same seed must reproduce across repeated calls, thread counts and save/load; no seed/data substitution after results.
